name: Speckle-winged Rangeland Grasshopper
desc: Speckle-winged Rangeland Grasshopper (Arphia conspersa): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Arphia conspersa, known generally as the speckle-winged rangeland grasshopper or speckled rangeland grasshopper, is a species of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae.
